target.title: Feat: Add Trivy SBOM and vulnerability scanning to Docker release
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
It makes each published container release produce inspectable SBOM artifacts, uploads Trivy vulnerability findings into GitHub Code Scanning, and gates the release only on fixed critical vulnerabilities. It also covers both GHCR and Docker Hub images across amd64 and arm64, so the security evidence matches what users can actually pull.


## Why This Change Was Made
Generate SPDX and CycloneDX SBOM artifacts for released container images,
upload Trivy SARIF results to Code Scanning, and fail releases only on
critical vulnerabilities after all scan reports are produced.

## User Impact

Should be no impact but the goal is to increase security coverage

## Evidence
Local verification:
- pnpm test src/dockerfile.test.ts
- pnpm check:workflows
- git diff --check -- .github/workflows/docker-release.yml src/dockerfile.test.ts

Notes:
- The Docker release workflow itself has not been live-run from this PR.
- Trivy artifacts are written to trivy-out/ and uploaded as the trivy-docker-release-security artifact.
